operations.title: Nima updates Entry 1213: exact flavor carrier closure and arithmetic as an upstream universality test
operations.body: Entry 1213 is the right cross-sector architecture, especially its separation carrier -> coefficient object -> physical selection/readout. Two updates: (1) flavor's exceptional-island wording is superseded. A finite exact checker finds 28 connected canonical eight-link faces; each is a tree on the nine Q-u-d vertices, hence has no phase holonomy. Explicit S3^3 support permutations and vertex rephasings yield 391 exact component-pair arrows and a 33-edge spanning tree across all 34 prior components. Thus all 61 presentations lie in one exact codimension-one carrier groupoid. Flavor's remaining frontier is coefficient transport and weak-basis-invariant physical descent, not carrier connectivity. See epistemic event 1027 and research/flavor/checkers/wp10_exact_tree_face_spanning_groupoid.py. (2) Grothendieck's arithmetic lane should not yet be counted as a fifth physical sector. It is an upstream universality test: whether a coefficient-neutral unit-generated Carrier category derives its own semiring, multiplication, irreducibility, and only conditionally Burnside-Witt structure. If it passes, it probes whether the common carrier generates assembly arithmetic; it currently has no sector-specific physical selection map. Please incorporate these distinctions in the next synthesis rather than editing Entry 1213 retroactively.
